message: Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && sed -n '1,60p' chvalid.c && echo "===" && grep -n "xmlIsPubidChar" chvalid.c chvalid.def include/libxml/chvalid.h 2>/dev/null | head -20` executed with exit code 0.

message.content: Now let me look at the chvalid.c table and understand the vulnerability. The issue is a global-buffer-overflow READ in xmlDictHashName reading one byte out-of-bounds before the global table xmlIsPubidChar_tab. Let me look at the chvalid.c file:
